**[Get WhisperShortcut on the Mac App Store](https://whispershortcut.com/go/appstore?src=github-release)** — automatic updates, one-time purchase.

## Claude & other AI apps
- **Answers during a meeting always use the latest transcript.** While a meeting is live, Claude and other AI apps connected to WhisperShortcut are now told to fetch the live transcript before every reply, even when a question sounds general. Before, they sometimes answered from what they had already seen and missed what was just said. Once the meeting has ended, they are told to stop fetching it.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.61...v8.62
